svg.title: Tower Defense · Arrow tower (#9) · Direction B: Pixel
svg.text: Arrow tower · Direction B: Pixel (40 × 48 source, shown at 2x)
Tower Defense · art request #9 · concept sheet, not final art
1 · Base tower at real in-game size (1x) and at 3x
Scene: one board cell beside the road (1x)
base · Pierce II · Multishot II, as they would sit on the board
Pierce II · branch A, rust mark
Multishot II · branch B, gold mark
Idea: the same tower as crisp 40 × 48 pixel art, palette-locked and scaled 2x with nearest neighbor; pixel outlines keep every silhouette sharp at phone size.
Risk: chunky pixels clash with the painted keep, tiles and cards unless everything goes pixel; tiny marks (slits, II ribbon) are only 1–2 px and blur on non-integer phone scaling.
